findings.failureScenario: The final result of library.importLightroom (returned by wait:true and by status polling via lightroom_last) has two shapes for the same outcome: a clean import stores the engine report itself (top-level imported/failed/photos/... plus path), while an import whose archive index write failed or whose commit reported an error stores {report:{...}, indexWarning|error, path}. A control/MCP client reading result.imported gets the count on success but null when only the index write warned, although the photos were added; terminal() papers over this internally with value.get("report").unwrap_or(&value), but external consumers see the drift.
findings.action: Always store the final result in one shape (e.g. {report, indexWarning?, error?, path}, or always flatten the report and add indexWarning/error alongside) and document it in docs/control-protocol.md; add a test asserting the shape for both clean and index-warning completions.
